title: Topic 4
japanese_text:
<ruby>Ａ：<rt></rt></ruby><ruby>机<rt>つくえ</rt></ruby><ruby>の<rt></rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt>うえ</rt></ruby><ruby>に<rt></rt></ruby><ruby><u>布</u><rt>ぬの</rt></ruby><ruby>と<u>はさみ</u>が<rt></rt></ruby><ruby>置<rt>お</rt></ruby><ruby>いてあったけど、どうしたの？<rt></rt></ruby>
<ruby>Ｂ：<rt></rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt>こ</rt></ruby><ruby>ども<rt></rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt>ふく</rt></ruby><ruby>を<rt></rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt>つく</rt></ruby><ruby>ったの。<rt></rt></ruby><ruby>見<rt>み</rt></ruby><ruby>て、これ。あとはこの<rt></rt></ruby><ruby><u>部分</u><rt>ぶぶん</rt></ruby><ruby>に<u>ゴム</u>を<rt></rt></ruby><ruby>通<rt>とお</rt></ruby><ruby>せば<rt></rt></ruby><ruby><u>完成</u><rt>かんせい</rt></ruby><ruby>するよ！<rt></rt></ruby>
<ruby>Ａ：へえ、かわいいね。<rt></rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt>き</rt></ruby><ruby>せるのが<rt></rt></ruby><ruby>楽<rt>たの</rt></ruby><ruby>しみだね。<rt></rt></ruby>
english_translation:
A: There was a cloth and scissors on the desk, but what happened to them?
B: I made some children's clothes. Look at this. I just have to put a rubber band through this part and it'll be finished!
A: Wow, it's cute. I'm looking forward to having them wear it.
